sourceRefs.locator: pp. 353–355, particularly p. 354. Royal confirmation of Landry’s privilege, sung praise on the model of Agaune, signatories and the king’s parents.
ARTEM 4511, Archives nationales AE II 6 (K 2 no. 3). Header, regest and ll. 3–4, naming the king’s parents Dagobert and Nanthild as buried in the basilica. Clichy, 22 June 654.
IV.79, pp. 66–67, including n. 1. Illness at Épinay, Aega, Nanthild, Clovis and burial at Saint-Denis. Wallace-Hadrill follows Courtois in dating the death to 638.

summary.de: Nanthild war die Mutter Chlodwigs II. Ihr Sohn nannte sie bei ihrem Namen, als er 654 die Bestattung seiner Eltern in Saint-Denis erwähnte.
summary.en: Clovis II’s mother. Her son referred to her by name in 654 when he mentioned his parents’ burial in Saint-Denis.
